payload.title: Checks cover front-matter prose, not only the body
payload.description: Wire items have no body: their text is the title and the one- or two-sentence take in front matter; rulings and commentary also carry dek, summary and ownerTakeaway there. checkItemVersion (and check-drafts) should check those fields as segments with their own provenance (field name), so wire takes, deks and owner takeaways are copy-edited too.
